messages.text:
"Create a polished 2D side-scrolling fantasy action platformer for Android mobile devices titled SHADOWBOUND: THE LAST LIGHT.

CORE GAMEPLAY:
Build a fully playable single-player offline platformer with responsive controls, smooth movement, jumping, double jumping, sword combat, enemies, collectibles, hazards, checkpoints and a level completion system.

ART DIRECTION:
Use beautiful high-quality 2D pixel art with a dark fantasy atmosphere, detailed environments, atmospheric lighting, glowing blue magical effects, layered parallax backgrounds and consistent character sprites. Keep all visuals coherent and readable on mobile screens.

PLAYER CHARACTER:
Create an original hooded warrior with idle, running, jumping, falling, attacking, taking damage and death animations. Implement horizontal movement, variable jump height, double jump, sword attack, health and invulnerability frames after taking damage.

MOBILE CONTROLS:
Use landscape orientation. Add large, responsive on-screen left and right movement buttons, jump and attack buttons. Support multi-touch so movement and jumping or attacking can happen simultaneously. Keep controls away from important gameplay visuals.

LEVEL ONE:
Create a complete introductory level in an enchanted dark forest. Include platforms at different heights, gaps, spikes, moving platforms, collectible coins, health pickups, enemy patrols and one checkpoint. Add a clear exit portal at the end.

ENEMIES:
Implement at least two enemy types: a ground skeleton that patrols and attacks when the player approaches, and a flying shadow creature that moves toward the player. Add health, damage feedback and defeat animations.

GAME INTERFACE:
Create a polished main menu with Play, Settings and Credits. During gameplay show health, collected coins and a pause button. Add a pause menu, game over screen and level completion screen. Include restart and return-to-menu options.

AUDIO:
Add suitable original or royalty-free fantasy background music and sound effects for jumping, sword attacks, collecting coins, taking damage and defeating enemies, with volume controls.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:
Ensure stable performance on Android phones, responsive landscape layouts, consistent physics, accurate collision detection, no character clipping through platforms, and no soft locks. Save player progress and collected rewards locally where supported. Do not require online multiplayer or a server.

DEVELOPMENT PRIORITY:
First build a fully functional playable prototype with the player, camera, physics, touch controls and one complete level. Then implement enemies, combat, UI, audio and polish. Prioritize working gameplay over decorative features. Test the complete level from start to finish and fix all critical bugs.

IMPORTANT:
Do not create static mockups or screenshots in place of a playable game. Implement actual interactive game mechanics. Use original characters and assets. If any feature is unsupported, implement the closest working alternative and clearly report the limitation.

DELIVERABLE:
A playable Android-oriented 2D platformer prototype with a complete first level, functional touch controls, combat, enemies, collectibles, checkpoint, menu and restart functionality.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
